answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 287 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, because the declared depth is logged in the knoll receipt and checked against the onyx nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the echo audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. That is 24 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
